ink-active.$description: Label color when active or pressed.

ink-focus.$description: Label color while the button has keyboard focus.

ink-expanded.$description: Label color while the button controls expanded content.

ink-expanded-hover.$description: Label color of an expanded button when hovered.

ink-expanded-active.$description: Label color of an expanded button while pressed.

ink-expanded-focus.$description: Label color of an expanded button with keyboard focus.

ink-expanded-disabled.$description: Label color of an expanded disabled button.

ink-loading.$description: Label color while the button is in its loading state.

canvas-focus.$description: Background while the button has keyboard focus.

canvas-expanded.$description: Background while the button controls expanded content.

canvas-expanded-hover.$description: Background of an expanded button when hovered.

canvas-expanded-active.$description: Background of an expanded button while pressed.

canvas-expanded-focus.$description: Background of an expanded button with keyboard focus.

canvas-expanded-disabled.$description: Background of an expanded disabled button.

canvas-loading.$description: Background while the button is in its loading state.

border-color-active.$description: Border color when the button is selected/active.

border-color-focus.$description: Border color while the button has keyboard focus.

border-color-expanded.$description: Border color while the button controls expanded content.

border-color-expanded-hover.$description: Border color of an expanded button when hovered.

border-color-expanded-active.$description: Border color of an expanded button while pressed.

border-color-expanded-focus.$description: Border color of an expanded button with keyboard focus.

border-color-expanded-disabled.$description: Border color of an expanded disabled button.

border-color-loading.$description: Border color while the button is in its loading state.

border-style.$description: Border style (solid, dashed, etc) for standard buttons.

font-size.$description: Base font size for button labels.

text-box-trim.$description: Which half-leading edges to trim off the label's text box. `trim-both` makes optical padding match the padding tokens; browsers without support fall back to the untrimmed box.

text-box-edge.$description: The font metrics text-box-trim trims to, e.g. `cap alphabetic`. Only takes effect where text-box-trim is set and the browser supports it.

gap.$description: Gap between button icon and label.

group-gap.$description: Gap between buttons when rendered in a group.

min-height.$description: Minimum height to ensure tappable area.

aspect-ratio.$description: Preferred width-to-height ratio of the button box. `1` squares an icon-only button without pinning either dimension.

icon-start-size.$description: Default icon size for icons at start of buttons.

icon-end-size.$description: Default icon size for icons at end of buttons.

icon-transform-expanded.$description: Icon transform while the button controls expanded content, for example rotating a disclosure chevron.

box-shadow-focus.$description: Box shadow in focus state (in addition to outline).

box-shadow-expanded.$description: Box shadow while the button controls expanded content.

box-shadow-expanded-hover.$description: Box shadow of an expanded button when hovered.

box-shadow-expanded-active.$description: Box shadow of an expanded button while pressed.

box-shadow-expanded-focus.$description: Box shadow of an expanded button with keyboard focus.

box-shadow-expanded-disabled.$description: Box shadow of an expanded disabled button.

box-shadow-disabled.$description: Box shadow for disabled buttons; flat by default so a raised base shadow doesn't imply the button is still actionable.

transform-focus.$description: Transform effect in focus state (in addition to outline).

transform-expanded.$description: Transform while the button controls expanded content.

transform-expanded-hover.$description: Transform of an expanded button when hovered.

transform-expanded-active.$description: Transform of an expanded button while pressed.

transform-expanded-focus.$description: Transform of an expanded button with keyboard focus.

transform-expanded-disabled.$description: Transform of an expanded disabled button.

transform-disabled.$description: Transform for disabled buttons; flat by default so a lifted base transform doesn't survive into the disabled state.

cursor.$description: Cursor style when hovering over buttons.

cursor-disabled.$description: Cursor style when hovering a disabled button.

cursor-loading.$description: Cursor style while the button is in its loading state.

flex-direction.$description: Direction of icon and label layout.

justify-content.$description: Main axis alignment for button contents.

align-items.$description: Cross axis alignment for button contents.

transition-property.$value: background-color, color, border-color, box-shadow, transform, outline
transition-property.$description: CSS properties that should animate on interaction.

transition-delay.$description: Delay before CSS properties run through their animate on interaction.

opacity-disabled.$description: Visual opacity for disabled buttons; disabled color tokens carry the state by default.

opacity-loading.$description: Visual opacity while the button is in its loading state.
